candidate_enumerable.meaning: for comparison: a candidate SITE exists inside the labeled function (constrained-detector group 1)

model_corroborated_one_hop.meaning: derive_shape resolves a source at the sink argument (one-hop) even when the fix mechanism is opaque

model_entailed_today.meaning: the model alone establishes the vuln differential: a source->sink with the fix's guard recognised, or an obligation undischarged on vuln and discharged on fixed, or a permissive literal changed

taint_reachable_multi_hop.meaning: sink argument's binding chain (depth 6) reaches a source token; the achievable corroboration band once the taint is deepened

command: offline abstract interpretation over the vendored corpus, no LLM
memory_slice: 176 pairs deferred to the execution/SMT tier; not a static gap
modeling: abstract interpretation (taint reachability + guard dominance + constant abstraction). SMT reserved for the deferred memory/C tier; concolic avoided by design (no interpreter, un-runnable targets).
note: The analogue of the candidate ceiling, one rung up: not 'can a site be enumerated' (96.6%) but 'can a deterministic model DECIDE the vulnerability without trusting the LLM'. An entailment witness is the static analogue of a reproduced crash.
verdict: The model cannot be a PURE arbiter at v1: deterministic abstract interpretation decides ~2% at entailment and ~24-35% at corroboration, far below the 96.6% at which a site can be handed to an LLM. The architecture the numbers support is a LAYERED arbiter: report model_entailed where the model proves it (deterministic, no LLM); let the LLM judge but CHECK its claim against the resolved taint on the corroboration band (noise removed there); honest `suspicion` for the rest, which is where the future execution/differential tier earns its place. The near-term work is deepening the abstract interpretation -- function naming, per-family sink/sanitizer tables, multi-hop taint reused from the candidate enumerator's depth-4 chain -- each measurable, the first knob already moved injection 24% -> 48%.
why_the_gap: one-hop source resolution at the sink argument: real bugs put the taint 1-3 binds upstream (q = '...'+id; execute(q)) and the shallow resolver stops at `q`
closed literal sink table: misses project wrappers (run_sql_query) and per-family sinks (path: open/join/send_file; xss: render/innerHTML; prototype: Object.assign/[key]=)
function-naming gap: 20/50 injection pairs report no_function because the CST names the labeled handler `<anon>` or a wrapper name -- the same defect that caps vfc-js candidate coverage
fix-mechanism recognition only fires when the guard lands inside the labeled function; decorator/middleware/config fixes are invisible to the in-function guard classifier
absence model finds no operation in 5/8 access_control: thin operation detection and cross-file decorators
